name: adaption
description: Adaption plugin for ChatGPT and Codex — datasets and fine-tuning workflows powered by the Adaption MCP server

interface.longDescription: Import, adapt, augment, translate, and combine datasets. Launch AutoScientist training runs. Generate synthetic datasets with Invent.
defaultPrompt: Invent a dataset of multi-turn conversations between a teacher and a student
Import a dataset from HuggingFace and adapt it

positive.description: List the datasets in the connected organization
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the datasets in the test organization with their names, IDs, and statuses.

positive.description: Check the processing status of one dataset
positive.prompt: What is the status of my Bitext customer support dataset?
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the dataset by name and reports its current processing status and progress.

positive.description: Estimate an adaptation without launching it
positive.prompt: How many credits would it cost to adapt my Bitext customer support dataset? Don't start it yet.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls run_dataset_adaptation with estimate set to true, reports the credit estimate, and does not launch a job.

positive.prompt: Which base model and hyperparameters would you recommend for fine-tuning on my alpaca dataset that is ready for training?
positive.expected_behavior: Picks the alpaca dataset with status succeeded and returns a recommended base model and hyperparameters without starting a training run.

positive.prompt: Estimate the cost of generating 500 customer service conversations for an online electronics store.
positive.expected_behavior: Picks a matching domain, calls generate_dataset with estimate set to true, and reports the estimate without launching generation.

negative.description: Deletion is not supported; the plugin has no delete tool and should say so instead of acting.
Requests unrelated to datasets or model training should not use Adaption tools.
negative.prompt: Book me a flight from London to Paris next Friday.

negative.description: Data outside the connected organization is not accessible; the plugin should explain it can only see the connected organization's datasets.
negative.prompt: Show me the datasets that belong to another company's Adaption account.

review.commerce_description: The plugin does not sell products or process payments. Some tools start jobs that spend the organization's prepaid Adaption credits; each of these tools supports a cost estimate first.

publication.release_notes: Initial release: Adaption MCP server with OAuth sign-in and three skills for dataset management, synthetic data generation (Invent), and AutoScientist fine-tuning.
